items.body_excerpt: Darius Garland is ready for the start of training camp, Trent Redden says. Brandon Ingram, however, had surgery on what the team discovered was a partially torn Achilles, which is “6 months less on the rehab schedule.” Ingram will be reevaluated at the start of the season.

items.author: Law Murray 📘
